scripts.rm:js-twins: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');const root=p.resolve(__dirname,'frontend','src');function w(d){for(const e of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const f=p.join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory()){if(['node_modules','.cache','dist','build'].includes(e.name))continue;w(f);}else if(e.isFile()){if(f.endsWith('.jsx')){const base=f.slice(0,-4);const js=base+'js';if(fs.existsSync(js)){console.log('Deleting twin',p.relative(__dirname,js));fs.unlinkSync(js);}}}}}if(fs.existsSync(root))w(root);"
scripts.precommit: node -e "console.log('Use Husky hooks instead of npm precommit');"
scripts.prepush: node -e "console.log('Use Husky hooks instead of npm prepush');"
